validated_objective: Implement QIF v0.4.2 Quality Aspect taxonomy as a non-checklist discovery lens model connected to quality-gate packages, examples, verifier rules, retained fixtures, and documentation.
scope: Add canonical Quality Aspects for functional, non-functional, usability, UX design, accessibility, performance, scalability, availability, reliability, recoverability, security, privacy, data quality, operational quality, maintainability, changeability, auditability, compliance, safety, cost, customer impact, brand trust, and organizational operability.
Connect Quality Aspects to quality-gate evaluation perspectives.
Add verifier rules and negative fixtures that reject aspect-as-quality misuse and broken aspect traceability.
Update docs, changelog, roadmap, and AOF evidence.
constraints: Do not make every aspect mandatory for every target.
Do not treat aspect coverage as evidence, verdict, or quality achievement.
Do not build UI or external integrations.
Do not claim verifier success proves semantic quality truth.
expected_outcomes: Quality Gate packages can record aspect exploration breadth.
npm test rejects invalid aspect definitions and aspect traceability failures.
Documentation makes the checklist boundary explicit.
